spans.s: sa-jala-sthala (EI 12, 27, 29), ‘together with land and waters [of the gift village]’.
sa-jala-sthal-āraṇya (EI 23), ‘together with the land, waters and jungles [of the gift village]’.
sa-jana-dhana (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, p. 139), same as jana-dhana-sahita. Cf. sa-jana (ibid., Vol. V, p. 185).
sa-jāṅgal-ānūpa (EI 12), ‘together with arid and marshy lands’.
